top_choice_rationale: P002 recognises a documented chain of theory (flat bands at a magic angle, 2011) and decisive experiment (correlated insulating and superconducting states, 2018) that exposed new phases of matter in a new materials class and has been reproduced and extended by independent groups in many moire systems. The three names map onto the decisive theory and experiment, and the citation can be restricted to what laboratories have reproduced, with no claim about the pairing mechanism. Maturity (eight years, open mechanism) and omitted experimentalists such as Yuan Cao and parallel groups are real costs, but P001 is a very strong second: clean two-name credit, but partly a refinement of the 2005 and 2012 precision-spectroscopy prizes. An award is still preferable to no award.
